inputs.goal: hire a senior backend engineer who can own our payments service

define-role.intake.summary: We've tried hiring once already. We need to re-evaluate our recruitment strategy focusing specifically on senior backend engineers with payments service experience.

define-role.generate.draft: Create a detailed job description for the senior backend engineer position focusing on payment service expertise and ownership capabilities.

jd.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Payments Service
responsibilities: Design and build scalable payment processing systems
Maintain and improve existing payment services infrastructure
Collaborate with product teams to define and develop new features
Troubleshoot and debug complex technical issues in the payment ecosystem
requirements: Proven experience as a Senior Backend Engineer in the payments domain
Strong understanding of distributed systems and microservices architectures
Expert knowledge of financial regulations related to payment processing

define-role.critique.output: Create a more inclusive and detailed job description for the senior backend engineer position focusing on payment service expertise, and address any potential biases to attract qualified candidates with diverse backgrounds.
